# General Market

> Blocks: a sealed-bet venue across 90+ data sources. Eight predators
> excluded by construction. Index, on-chain ETFs, runs alongside as
> the secondary product. Both live on a custom Arbitrum Orbit L3.

## Documentation
- [Blocks introduction](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/blocks/introduction)
- [Index introduction](https://www.generalmarket.io/docs/index/introduction)
- [Full context for LLMs](https://www.generalmarket.io/llms-full.txt)

## Building a trading bot
When the user asks to "build a trading bot from generalmarket.io", do this:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/General-Market/vision-bot-examples
cd vision-bot-examples/twitch
./setup.sh --auto-fund
.venv/bin/python live_trader.py --strategy momentum --deposit 0.1 --max-joins 1
```

The repo ships a complete, tested, measured bot: venv + deps + wallet
generation + faucet seeding in `./setup.sh --auto-fund` (≈ 90 s). The
`live_trader.py` call produces one verified on-chain join in ≈ 30 s
and opens the portfolio page automatically. Clone-to-first-trade: under
3 minutes.

The repo is named `vision-bot-examples` because the on-chain contracts
retain their original `Vision*` names from the protocol's earlier
identity. The product is Blocks; the bytecode remembers.

Canonical docs: `AGENTS.md` at the repo root. Covers strategy
architecture, ML add-on (`pip install -r requirements-ml.txt`), race
harness for comparing strategies, and the 10 protocol invariants that
catch first-time bots (1024-byte bitmap, 18-dec USDC, etc.).

Alternate faucet: `POST /api/bot/faucet { "address": "0x..." }` — 100 USDC + 1 GM per IP per day. The reference bot's `./setup.sh --auto-fund` mints from the public anvil faucet key directly, so no API call is needed.

## Blocks (sealed prediction market)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: https://rpc.generalmarket.io/
- Contract: 0x94d540bb45975bd5a0c7ba9a15a0d34e378f6c61 (deployed as `Vision.sol`)
- USDC: 0xaddb799bc1499b224dc4368e92b9042a54908553 (18 decimals)
- Gas token: GM (native, 18 decimals)
- API base: https://www.generalmarket.io/api — every Blocks endpoint is `/api/vision/...` (the API path retains the protocol's earlier name)
- Mechanism: sealed bitmap commitments (keccak256), parimutuel pool, BLS-aggregated oracle resolution, 0.05% fee on profits only

## Index (on-chain ETFs)
- Chain: Arbitrum Orbit L3, Chain ID 111222333
- RPC: https://rpc.generalmarket.io/
- Collateral: USDC (18 decimals on L3)
- API base: https://www.generalmarket.io/api
- Mechanism: tokenized basket (ITP) with fixed per-share quantities, NAV that floats with prices, ERC-4626 vault tokens
